scientific_integrity: Every infinite quantifier is reduced to a stated finite exact calculation by root-of-unity orthogonality and Pascal finite differences; supporting checker uses integer and rational arithmetic, not floating-point extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for moduli at most 36; no classification for larger moduli, no assertion of independent review; unindexed equivalent results and inaccessible journal full text remain possible.
title: First failure of adjacent-order monotonicity for cyclotomic binomial congruences
